required_services: LLM provider key for extraction stages (openai/anthropic/google/cerebras/openrouter)
compatibility.runtime_topology: Separate SurrealDB Agent Memory / Spectron HTTP service in front of SurrealDB; clients call endpoint+api_key; no supported in-process embedded library
storage_requirements: SurrealDB durable store for graph/vector/document memory
Object store for raw document bytes
compatibility.surrealdb_driver_note: surrealdb 2.x stable has no memory extra; memory client requires surrealdb 3.x prerelease

decision.operational_complexity: Agent Memory adds Spectron service + object store + mandatory Gemini embeddings + LLM provider keys on top of SurrealDB; native baseline already owns temporal/provenance/scope/live-revalidation contracts without those dependencies.
patterns_to_retain_as_reference: explicit scope lens / fail-closed grants (aligned with #39 MemoryScope)
decision.reason: Fair live Agent Memory evaluation is BLOCKED_EXTERNAL_MODEL_DEPENDENCY (mandatory gemini-embedding-2 + Spectron HTTP service; no authorized local no-cost path). Hard adoption gates cannot pass. Operational dependency burden is disproportionate versus the native Agent-Brain baseline that already implements #37/#39/#10/#11 contracts.
reevaluation_would_require: Official local/no-cost embedding path (or explicit authorized paid eval budget)
Pinned disposable Spectron image digest usable in CI without unknown volumes
Demonstrable material reduction of Agent-Brain backend complexity OR clear retrieval gain
Proof that Live-State Authority remains 100% Agent-Brain-owned under adapter

decision_matrix.adoption_requirement: AM P95 <= native P95 + 200ms OR <= 2x native

decision_matrix.agent_memory: Spectron service + SurrealDB + object store + Gemini embeddings
decision_matrix.native: in-process native ports + optional pinned Surreal read runtime
